observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with visible wear, grime, and some blue paint marks. A black cylindrical component with 'BM' written on it is attached to the side.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same transmission, focusing on the rear section. A label with Chinese characters is visible on the black component, and a multi-colored wire harness is attached.
Photo 2 shows the front of the transmission, with a star-shaped cover and a large gear housing. The surface is heavily soiled and dirty.
All photos have a watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the transmission body or components in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts and gearbox', but no Japanese origin markings are visible.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No visible Japanese origin markings or brand names are readable in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

risks.risk: The transmission may be damaged or non-functional due to visible wear, grime, and lack of inspection.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the internal gears, fluid condition, and any signs of leaks or damage.

risks.risk: The transmission may not be from a Japanese vehicle, contradicting the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any brand or model markings on the transmission body or components.

risks.risk: The transmission may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the transmission's serial number and any damage indicators.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any brand or model markings on the transmission body or components.
Close-up video or photo of the internal gears and fluid condition.
Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or serial number if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
